name: Prejanopterus
isnote: Recovered between Pterodactylus and Ctenochasmatoidea (Pereda-Suberbiola et al. 2012) or as a possible lonchodectid (Witton 2013).
sum: The best-preserved pterosaur of Spain, from the lower Aptian of La Rioja, with a curiously bent snout.
wsnote: Initially estimated 4.26 m; later studies suggest not much over 2 m.
holotype: F. A. 112 (fragmented snout) — Leza Formation, Préjano, La Rioja.
material: Disarticulated material: two snouts, other skull and postcranial bones.
biology: Twenty pairs of small oval teeth in a curved upper jaw and straight lower jaws.
author: Vidarte and Calvo 2010
